headline: 6 contract addresses catalogued across Ethereum and BSC from block-explorer name-tag searches; no canonical deployed-contracts doc found; multi-chain deployments on 15+ chains not yet enumerated.

findings.text: Etherscan name-tag search returned 3 addresses on Ethereum: 0xE2fE530C (Team Finance Lock, AdminUpgradeabilityProxy), 0x64D06dcc (Team Finance Vesting, VestingFactory), and 0xb05AF453 (TEAM Token). BSCScan returned 0x0C89C0407 (Team Finance Security/Lock, AdminUpgradeabilityProxy on BSC). SWAP token proxy 0xCC4304A31 also surfaced on Ethereum. Implementation address 0x6dd27f2b (LockToken.sol) surfaced as EIP-1967 implementation for the Lock proxy.

Handbook at handbook.team.finance has no dedicated deployed-contracts or addresses page; llms.txt index does not list one. No deployed_contracts_doc URL found. protocol_metadata.deployed_contracts_doc set to null.

The pinned audit link (https://www.team.finance/file/audit.pdf) redirected to the handbook security page (not a direct PDF). That page names Hacken and Chainsulting as auditors, and references a BailSec SWAP token audit PDF. The website security page names Certik, Hacken, and BailSec. A GlobeNewsWire press release (Sept 2026) lists auditors as CertiK, Hacken, BailSec, and Zokyo. No in-scope contract address table was extractable because no audit PDF body was fetched.

GitHub organization is 'trustswap' (confirmed at github.com/trustswap/teamfinance-widget-staking). The staking widget repo hardcodes BSC mainnet staking pool contract 0x101119A32aFb86D3fAD674baE0a8dC9EE5f69CEE. The repo README notes the widget moved to github.com/trustswap/teamfinance-widgets. No Foundry/hardhat deployment artifacts or deployment JSON found in the fetched repo (widget-only code). Core smart contract repos were not directly fetchable in this run.

Protocol operates on 17+ chains per pinned context. DeFiLlama confirms active TVL on Ethereum, BSC, Base, Avalanche, Polygon, PulseChain, and Arbitrum. Only Ethereum and BSC addresses were surfaced via D1. Base, Avalanche, Polygon, PulseChain, Arbitrum, Blast, Cronos, Fantom, Kava, Flare, Klaytn, Odyssey, Mantle, LUKSO, and Berachain deployments not enumerated — recorded in unknowns.

The Ethereum lock contract 0xE2fE530C and BSC lock contract 0x0C89C0407 are custody/locker contracts (not factories with enumerable children). The vesting contract 0x64D06dcc is labeled VestingFactory but no child enumeration was performed due to tool-call budget exhaustion. No read-API calls executed this run.

Role taxonomy applied: Lock contracts classified as 'vault' (AdminUpgradeabilityProxy shape); Vesting as 'factory'; staking pool as 'pool'; TEAM token as 'token'; SWAP token (governance) as 'token'. Implementation contract classified as 'other' (logic contract).
All 7 addresses in admin_addresses[] trace to fetched Etherscan/BSCScan search result pages or the GitHub widget repo. No snippet-only sightings without page bodies.

rationale.verdict: Discovery run walked website, handbook, GitHub (staking widget repo), Etherscan name-tag search results, BSCScan name-tag result, DeFiLlama, and a GlobeNewsWire press release. 7 addresses catalogued across Ethereum and BSC. Multi-chain deployments on 15 additional chains remain unenumerated. No canonical deployed-contracts doc was found. grade=unknown because the catalogue is materially incomplete — only 2 of 17+ chains have any surfaced addresses.

protocol_metadata.about: Team Finance is a non-custodial token management platform that allows crypto projects to create tokens, lock team and liquidity tokens in time-released vaults, set up investor and employee vesting schedules, and configure staking pools. Deployed across 26+ EVM and non-EVM blockchains, its locking and vesting contracts use an AdminUpgradeabilityProxy (EIP-1967 transparent proxy) pattern audited by CertiK, Hacken, BailSec, and Zokyo. It is a product of TrustSwap Inc. and is distinct from the SWAP governance token; assets locked through Team Finance are held by the smart contracts themselves rather than by TrustSwap. The platform has processed over 40,000 projects and held over $6 billion in TVL at peak.
